meaning_en: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
formation: Noun + に際して / Verb-dict + に際して / Noun + に際しての + Noun
ex_ja: 新製品の発売に際して、記者会見が開かれた。
ex_en: A press conference was held on the occasion of the new product's launch.
notes: Formal; for special, one-off occasions (ceremonies, departures, contracts). Near-synonym of 〜にあたって, which adds a sense of preparing for or facing the event; に際して simply marks the occasion.

meaning_en: along with; as; accompanying
formation: Noun + に伴って / Verb-dict + の + に伴って / Noun + に伴う + Noun
ex_ja: 高齢化に伴って、医療費は年々増加している。
ex_en: Along with the aging of the population, medical costs are rising year by year.
notes: 〜に伴い is the more written form. Like 〜につれて it can describe gradual change, but it also covers one-off events that bring about another (e.g. a relocation).

meaning_en: according to; depending on; in response to
formation: Noun + に応じて / Noun + に応じた + Noun
ex_ja: この奨学金は、家庭の収入に応じて支給額が変わる。
ex_en: The amount of this scholarship varies according to household income.
notes: B is adjusted to match A (ability, budget, season, requests). Compare 〜次第で, which stresses that the outcome is decided entirely by A.

meaning_en: contrary to; against; in violation of
formation: Noun + に反して / Noun + に反する + Noun / Noun + に反した + Noun
ex_ja: 大方の予想に反して、無名の新人が優勝した。
ex_en: Contrary to most people's predictions, an unknown newcomer won the championship.
notes: Used with nouns like 予想, 期待, 意思, 規則. With a rule or law as the noun, it means 'in violation of'.

meaning_en: based on; on the basis of
formation: Noun + に基づいて / Noun + に基づく + Noun / Noun + に基づいた + Noun
ex_ja: この映画は実際に起きた事件に基づいて制作された。
ex_en: This film was made based on an incident that actually happened.
notes: The basis is a firm standard such as data, law, facts or experience, and B follows it closely. Compare 〜をもとに, used for material from which something new is created.

meaning_en: over; throughout; spanning (a whole period or area)
formation: Noun + にわたって / Noun + にわたる + Noun
ex_ja: 工事は三か月にわたって行われる予定だ。
ex_en: The construction is scheduled to take place over three months.
notes: Stresses the full extent of a long period, a wide area or many items (多岐にわたる). Not used for short or small spans.

meaning_en: along; in line with; following
formation: Noun + に沿って / Noun + に沿った + Noun
ex_ja: 川に沿って桜並木が二キロほど続いている。
ex_en: A row of cherry trees stretches for about two kilometers along the river.
notes: Literal use: along a road, river or coast. Abstract use: following a plan, policy, or someone's wishes.

meaning_en: in addition to; on top of
formation: Noun + に加えて
ex_ja: 今年は猛暑に加えて雨不足が続き、野菜の価格が高騰している。
ex_en: This year, on top of the extreme heat, there has been a prolonged lack of rain, and vegetable prices have soared.
notes: Somewhat formal; 〜に加え is the written form. The added item is often marked with も.

meaning_en: over; concerning; surrounding (an issue of dispute)
formation: Noun + をめぐって / Noun + をめぐる + Noun
ex_ja: 新しい空港の建設をめぐって、住民の意見が二つに分かれている。
ex_en: Residents are divided over the construction of a new airport.
notes: The verb that follows is about debate, conflict or competition (議論する, 対立する, 争う). Unlike 〜について, it isn't used for simply explaining a topic.

meaning_en: through; via; by way of; throughout (a period)
formation: Noun + を通じて / Noun + を通して
ex_ja: 共通の友人を通じて、今の妻と知り合った。
ex_en: I got to know my wife through a mutual friend.
notes: Largely interchangeable. 〜を通して tends to stress a deliberate process or experience; 〜を通じて is a little more formal and common with media, contacts and periods (一年を通じて).

meaning_en: taking the opportunity of; triggered by; with ... as the start
formation: Noun + をきっかけに / Noun + をきっかけとして / Verb-plain + の + をきっかけに
ex_ja: 大学時代の留学をきっかけに、国際協力の仕事に興味を持つようになった。
ex_en: Studying abroad in college got me interested in international cooperation work.
notes: Marks an event that led to a new start or change. The formal equivalent 〜を契機に is common in writing.

meaning_en: except; excluding; apart from
formation: Noun + を除いて / Noun + を除き / Noun + を除く + Noun
ex_ja: 年末年始を除いて、図書館は毎日開いている。
ex_en: The library is open every day except during the New Year holidays.
notes: More formal than 〜以外. 〜を除き is the written form.

meaning_en: as if; as though (when it isn't really so)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + かのようだ / na-Adj + である + かのようだ / Noun + である + かのようだ
ex_ja: 彼はまるで何も知らないかのような顔をしていた。
ex_en: He wore a look as if he knew nothing at all.
notes: More literary than 〜ようだ and clearly signals that the comparison is not literally true. Often paired with まるで. Also 〜かのように / 〜かのような.

meaning_en: could well; might (lead to something bad)
formation: Verb-stem + かねない
ex_ja: そんな無理な運転をしていたら、大事故を起こしかねない。
ex_en: If you keep driving that recklessly, you could end up causing a serious accident.
notes: Only for undesirable outcomes. Despite the ない, the meaning is positive: 'there's a real risk that ...'. Don't confuse with 〜かねる (cannot).

meaning_en: cannot; be unable to (polite refusal); find it hard to
formation: Verb-stem + かねる
ex_ja: 申し訳ございませんが、そのご質問にはお答えしかねます。
ex_en: I'm very sorry, but I'm unable to answer that question.
notes: A soft, formal way to decline, very common in customer service. It expresses reluctance or difficulty for the speaker, not physical inability.

meaning_en: can't help doing; can't resist doing
formation: Verb-nai stem + ずにはいられない
ex_ja: あまりにひどいニュースに、怒りを感じずにはいられなかった。
ex_en: I couldn't help feeling angry at such terrible news.
notes: する becomes せずにはいられない. 〜ないではいられない is a slightly more conversational equivalent. An inner urge, unlike 〜ざるを得ない (forced by circumstances).

meaning_en: have no choice but to; cannot help but
formation: Verb-nai stem + ざるを得ない
ex_ja: 予算が足りないので、計画を縮小せざるを得ない。
ex_en: The budget is insufficient, so we have no choice but to scale back the plan.
notes: Circumstances force an action the speaker doesn't really want to take. する becomes せざるを得ない. More formal than 〜しかない.

meaning_en: can't afford to (keep) doing; can't just
formation: Verb-te + はいられない
ex_ja: 締め切りが迫っているので、のんびりしてはいられない。
ex_en: The deadline is approaching, so I can't afford to take it easy.
notes: The situation doesn't allow one to stay in state A, so one feels pushed to act. Casual: 〜ちゃいられない / 〜てらんない.

meaning_en: no way (will I); as if; I'll never
formation: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものか
ex_ja: あんな失礼な店には、二度と行くものか。
ex_en: No way am I ever going to that rude shop again.
notes: Strong emotional denial or refusal; not a real question. Conversational form: 〜もんか; polite/feminine: 〜ものですか.

meaning_en: although; even though (but the expected result doesn't follow)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ものの
ex_ja: 免許は取ったものの、怖くてまだ一度も運転していない。
ex_en: Although I got my license, I'm too scared and still haven't driven once.
notes: Admits the first fact, then says things didn't go as it would suggest. More written than 〜けれども.

meaning_en: if (it were possible); if only one could
formation: Verb-dict (potential form) + ものなら
ex_ja: できるものなら、学生時代に戻ってもう一度やり直したい。
ex_en: If only I could, I'd go back to my student days and do it all over again.
notes: For something hard or impossible to do; the main clause is often 〜たい or a challenge. Don't confuse with N1 〜(よ)うものなら ('if one dared to ..., something bad would happen').

meaning_en: rather than; if it comes to (doing that), I'd rather
formation: Verb-dict + くらいなら / Verb-dict + ぐらいなら
ex_ja: あんな人に頭を下げるくらいなら、会社を辞めたほうがましだ。
ex_en: I'd rather quit my job than bow my head to someone like him.
notes: A is something the speaker strongly dislikes; B is the lesser evil or better choice, often with 〜ほうがいい / 〜ほうがましだ.

meaning_en: there is something (about it that is) ...; it really is
formation: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものがある
ex_ja: この画家の初期の作品には、見る人の心を強く打つものがある。
ex_en: There is something in this painter's early works that deeply moves the viewer.
notes: Expresses the speaker's strong impression of a quality sensed in something. It's an evaluation, not a statement about literal existence.

meaning_en: how ...!; how much ...!
formation: Question word + … + Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことか
ex_ja: この日が来るのを、どれほど待ち望んだことか。
ex_en: How long I've waited for this day to come!
notes: Usually paired with どんなに, どれほど, 何度, etc. Not a real question; it conveys deep feeling. Slightly written or dramatic in tone.

meaning_en: (emotion)-ly; what is (surprising, sad, etc.) is that
formation: Verb-ta / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことに（は）
ex_ja: 驚いたことに、彼は会社を辞めてパン屋を開いたそうだ。
ex_en: Surprisingly, I heard he quit his company and opened a bakery.
notes: An emotion word (驚いた, 残念な, うれしい, 不思議な) states the speaker's feeling before giving the fact. Fairly written.

meaning_en: knowing (someone); since it's (someone), surely
formation: Noun + の + ことだから
ex_ja: 几帳面な彼のことだから、書類はもう準備してあるだろう。
ex_en: Knowing how meticulous he is, he's probably got the documents ready already.
notes: From what the speaker knows of a person's character, it leads to a guess about their behavior. Usually followed by だろう, きっと or に違いない.

meaning_en: without (doing); without ever
formation: Verb-dict + ことなく
ex_ja: 彼は三十年間、一日も休むことなく店を開け続けた。
ex_en: For thirty years, he kept his shop open without taking a single day off.
notes: A written equivalent of 〜ないで / 〜ずに, often implying that something one might expect to happen did not.

meaning_en: from the fact that; because; judging from
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ことから
ex_ja: この坂は、昔から桜の名所であることから「桜坂」と呼ばれている。
ex_en: This slope is called 'Sakura-zaka' because it has long been a famous spot for cherry blossoms.
notes: Gives the evidence or origin behind a name, judgment or conclusion. Common in explanations of place names and in reports.

meaning_en: unless; if ... not (then it can't happen)
formation: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない / Noun + でない + ことには
ex_ja: 実際に会って話してみないことには、どんな人か分からない。
ex_en: You can't tell what someone is like unless you actually meet and talk to them.
notes: The main clause is negative (分からない, できない, 始まらない): without A, B can't happen. More emphatic than 〜なければ.

meaning_en: it's true that ..., but; (I) do ..., but
formation: Verb-plain + ことは + Verb-plain + が / i-Adj + ことは + i-Adj + が / na-Adj + な + ことは + na-Adj + だ + が
ex_ja: あの映画、見たことは見たけど、途中で寝てしまった。
ex_en: I did watch that movie, but I fell asleep halfway through.
notes: The same word is repeated to admit something only partly before adding a reservation. けど replaces が in speech.

meaning_en: after (a long, troublesome process); in the end
formation: Verb-ta + あげく / Noun + の + あげく
ex_ja: さんざん迷ったあげく、結局どちらも買わなかった。
ex_en: After agonizing over it for ages, in the end I didn't buy either.
notes: The result is usually negative or disappointing. 〜末(に) is neutral and can end well; あげく stresses frustration. あげくの果てに is an intensified form.

meaning_en: so much that; out of excessive; because of too much
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + あまり（に）
ex_ja: 彼女は緊張のあまり、スピーチの内容を忘れてしまった。
ex_en: She was so nervous that she forgot what she was going to say in her speech.
notes: An extreme degree of a feeling or state leads to an unusual, often unwanted result. Mostly with emotion nouns (緊張, 心配, 驚き, 悲しみ).

meaning_en: besides; on top of; in addition to
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + である + 上（に）
ex_ja: あのレストランは料理がおいしい上に、値段も手頃だ。
ex_en: That restaurant has delicious food, and on top of that, the prices are reasonable.
notes: Adds a second point of the same kind (good + good, bad + bad). に may be dropped in writing. It isn't normally followed by a command or request.

meaning_en: after (doing), upon; in (doing), when it comes to
formation: Verb-ta + 上で / Noun + の + 上で / Verb-dict + 上で
ex_ja: 家族とよく相談した上で、お返事いたします。
ex_en: I'll give you my answer after discussing it carefully with my family.
notes: Verb-ta + 上で: do A first, then B on that basis. Verb-dict + 上で: 'in the process of / for the purpose of A'. Business writing often shortens it to ご確認の上.

meaning_en: since; now that; as long as
formation: Verb-plain / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 以上（は）
ex_ja: 引き受けた以上は、最後まで責任を持ってやり遂げるつもりだ。
ex_en: Now that I've taken it on, I intend to see it through responsibly to the end.
notes: From a given situation, draws an obligation, resolve or firm judgment. Near-synonym of 〜からには; 以上は sounds more formal and logical, からには more like personal resolve.

meaning_en: now that; since (having done/being ..., one must)
formation: Verb-plain / Noun + である + からには
ex_ja: オリンピックに出るからには、メダルを狙いたい。
ex_en: Since I'm competing in the Olympics, I want to go for a medal.
notes: Expresses resolve: having reached this situation, one should see it through. Often ends with 〜たい, 〜つもりだ, 〜なければならない. Compare 〜以上(は), which is more formal and neutral.

meaning_en: precisely because; it is because ... that
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + からこそ
ex_ja: 君のことを思っているからこそ、厳しいことを言うんだ。
ex_en: It's precisely because I care about you that I'm being hard on you.
notes: Stresses that this reason, and no other, is the real one, often a reason the listener wouldn't expect. Frequently ends with 〜のだ.

meaning_en: judging from; (starting) even with; to begin with
formation: Noun + からして
ex_ja: 空の様子からして、午後は雨になりそうだ。
ex_en: Judging from the look of the sky, it's likely to rain in the afternoon.
notes: Two uses: 'judging from X' (basis for a guess), and 'even X, let alone the rest', where one example stands for the whole, often critically.

meaning_en: judging from; from the standpoint of
formation: Noun + からすると / Noun + からすれば
ex_ja: あの話し方からすると、彼は関西の出身だろう。
ex_en: Judging from the way he talks, he's probably from the Kansai area.
notes: Gives either the evidence for a judgment or the viewpoint of a person. Close to 〜から見ると; unlike 〜からいうと, it can take a person.

meaning_en: from the point of view of; judging from; seen from
formation: Noun + から見ると / Noun + から見れば
ex_ja: 外国人から見ると、日本の習慣には不思議なものが多いらしい。
ex_en: Apparently, from a foreigner's point of view, many Japanese customs seem strange.
notes: Looks at something from a person's position or from given evidence. 〜から見て and 〜から見ても are also common.

meaning_en: in terms of; from the standpoint of; judging by
formation: Noun + からいうと / Noun + からいって
ex_ja: 立地からいうと、駅前のマンションのほうが便利だ。
ex_en: In terms of location, the apartment in front of the station is more convenient.
notes: The noun is a criterion or viewpoint (立場, 経験, 値段), not a person: say 親からすると, not ×親からいうと. 〜からいえば is also used.

meaning_en: when; at the time of; on the occasion of
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + 際（に）
ex_ja: お降りの際は、お忘れ物のないようご注意ください。
ex_en: When getting off, please make sure you don't leave anything behind.
notes: A formal version of 〜とき, common in announcements and instructions. Unlike 〜に際して, it's fine for everyday occasions.

meaning_en: as soon as (then immediately)
formation: Verb-stem + 次第 / Noun + 次第
ex_ja: 詳しい日程が決まり次第、皆様にご連絡いたします。
ex_en: We will contact everyone as soon as the detailed schedule is decided.
notes: Formal, for a planned future action that follows right after A (contacting, starting). Not used when the main clause is in the past. Compare 〜次第で (depending on).

meaning_en: depending on; it depends on
formation: Noun + 次第だ / Noun + 次第で / Noun + 次第では
ex_ja: 合格できるかどうかは、これからの努力次第だ。
ex_en: Whether you pass depends on your efforts from now on.
notes: The outcome is decided by A. 〜次第では points to one possible outcome among several.

meaning_en: after (a long process of); finally, at the end of
formation: Verb-ta + 末（に） / Noun + の + 末（に）
ex_ja: 半年にわたる交渉の末、両社はようやく合意に達した。
ex_en: After six months of negotiations, the two companies finally reached an agreement.
notes: Neutral: the outcome may be good or bad and is often a decision or conclusion. Use 〜あげく when the result is negative or frustrating.

meaning_en: even if (it would be no use); no matter how much
formation: Verb-ta + ところで
ex_ja: 今から急いだところで、終電には間に合わないだろう。
ex_en: Even if we hurry now, we probably won't make the last train.
notes: The main clause says the effort is useless or the result wouldn't matter much. Often with いくら, どんなに, 今さら. Different from 〜たところ (when I did, I found).

meaning_en: when (I) did ..., (I found that); upon doing
formation: Verb-ta + ところ
ex_ja: 駅の窓口で問い合わせたところ、その電車は運休しているとのことだった。
ex_en: When I asked at the station window, I was told that the train wasn't running.
notes: Reports what turned out after an action, often a discovery. The result is a past fact beyond the speaker's control. More formal than 〜たら.

meaning_en: not only ... but also
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ばかりか
ex_ja: 彼は約束の時間に遅れたばかりか、謝りもしなかった。
ex_en: Not only was he late, he didn't even apologize.
notes: Stronger than 〜だけでなく; the second item is often more surprising and marked by も, まで or さえ. Unlike 〜だけでなく, it isn't followed by commands or requests.

meaning_en: simply because; just because (with a bad result)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ばかりに
ex_ja: 確認を一つ怠ったばかりに、大きな損害を出してしまった。
ex_en: Simply because I skipped one check, I ended up causing heavy losses.
notes: The main clause is an unwanted result, often with regret. The set form 〜たいばかりに ('just because one wanted to') explains a strong motive.

meaning_en: keep (getting worse); only continue to
formation: Verb-dict + ばかりだ
ex_ja: 駅前の商店街は、客が減るばかりだ。
ex_en: The shopping street in front of the station just keeps losing customers.
notes: Change continuing in one direction, almost always for the worse. 〜一方だ (N3) is similar but can also describe neutral or good trends.

meaning_en: not to mention; of course ... and also
formation: Noun + はもちろん / Noun + はもとより
ex_ja: この公園は、週末はもちろん平日も家族連れでにぎわう。
ex_en: This park is busy with families on weekdays, not to mention weekends.
notes: A is the obvious case; B is added with も or まで. 〜はもとより is more formal and written than 〜はもちろん.

meaning_en: setting aside; regardless of; whatever about
formation: Noun + はともかく / Noun + はともかくとして
ex_ja: 見た目はともかく、味はなかなかいい。
ex_en: Looks aside, it tastes pretty good.
notes: Sets A aside to focus on B, which the speaker sees as more important. Compare 〜はさておき, used more to shelve a topic for now and move on.

meaning_en: leaving aside; putting aside (for now)
formation: Noun + はさておき
ex_ja: 冗談はさておき、そろそろ本題に入りましょう。
ex_en: Joking aside, let's get down to business.
notes: Often used to switch to the main point, as in 冗談はさておき or それはさておき. Slightly more formal than 〜はともかく.

meaning_en: on the other hand; while (it is ...)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 反面
ex_ja: 都会の暮らしは便利な反面、ストレスも多い。
ex_en: City life is convenient, but on the other hand it's also stressful.
notes: Presents two opposite sides of the same thing. 〜一方で (N3) is broader and can also contrast two different things.

meaning_en: although; despite; while (contrary to expectation)
formation: Verb-stem / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + ながら（も）
ex_ja: 狭いながらも、日当たりのいい快適な部屋だ。
ex_en: Although it's small, it's a comfortable, sunny room.
notes: Not the 'while doing' ながら: the subject is in state A, yet B is true. Set phrases: 残念ながら, 知りながら, 及ばずながら.

meaning_en: while (doing); although, even while
formation: Verb-stem + つつ / Verb-stem + つつも
ex_ja: 今年の業績を振り返りつつ、来年の目標を考えたい。
ex_en: While looking back on this year's results, I'd like to think about next year's goals.
notes: つつ alone is a written 〜ながら (two actions at once). つつも means 'although', typically with verbs of knowing or thinking (思いつつ, 知りつつ).

meaning_en: be in the process of; be gradually (changing)
formation: Verb-stem + つつある
ex_ja: 地球の平均気温は、年々上昇しつつある。
ex_en: The earth's average temperature is steadily rising year by year.
notes: Written style for change that is underway toward some result. Used with change verbs (増える, 回復する, 変わる), not with simple ongoing actions like 食べる.

meaning_en: leaving (something) as is; keep (doing) without a break
formation: Verb-stem + っぱなし
ex_ja: 部屋の電気をつけっぱなしにして出かけてしまった。
ex_en: I went out and left the light on in my room.
notes: Either something left undone that should have been dealt with (often a complaint), or a state that goes on without a break. Conversational.

meaning_en: do to the very end; see through; do thoroughly
formation: Verb-stem + 抜く
ex_ja: 足を痛めていたが、彼は最後まで走り抜いた。
ex_en: Although he had hurt his leg, he ran all the way to the finish.
notes: Stresses finishing something hard despite difficulty, or doing it to the fullest (考え抜く, 生き抜く).

meaning_en: can; be possible / cannot; be impossible
formation: Verb-stem + 得る / Verb-stem + 得ない
ex_ja: どんなに注意していても、事故は起こり得る。
ex_en: No matter how careful you are, accidents can happen.
notes: Logical possibility, not personal skill (not ×泳ぎ得る for 'can swim'). The positive is read うる or える; other forms use え- (えない, えた).

meaning_en: hard to; almost impossible to (emotionally)
formation: Verb-stem + がたい
ex_ja: あの誠実な人が不正をしたとは、信じがたい。
ex_en: It's hard to believe that such an honest person committed fraud.
notes: Used with verbs of thinking and feeling (信じる, 理解する, 許す, 離れる). Unlike 〜にくい, not for physical difficulty (×この肉は食べがたい).

meaning_en: there's no way to; cannot possibly (no means available)
formation: Verb-stem + ようがない / Noun + の + しようがない
ex_ja: 連絡先が分からないので、知らせようがない。
ex_en: I don't have his contact details, so there's no way to let him know.
notes: There's no method at all, even if one wanted to. 〜ようもない is more emphatic. With suru-nouns: 説明のしようがない.

meaning_en: if (you are like this / keep doing this), (it's no good)
formation: Verb-plain + ようでは
ex_ja: こんな簡単なミスをするようでは、大きな仕事は任せられない。
ex_en: If you make simple mistakes like this, we can't trust you with big jobs.
notes: Criticizes an undesirable state and predicts a bad outcome; the main clause is negative (〜ない, 困る, だめだ).

meaning_en: can't help (feeling); feel terribly; extremely
formation: Verb-te + ならない / i-Adj-ku + てならない / na-Adj + でならない
ex_ja: 故郷の母のことが心配でならない。
ex_en: I can't stop worrying about my mother back home.
notes: For feelings or impressions that arise on their own (気がする, 思われる, 心配だ, 残念だ). More formal and written than 〜てたまらない / 〜てしょうがない.

meaning_en: only by (doing); only when
formation: Verb-te + こそ
ex_ja: 自分で経験してこそ、本当の意味で理解できるのだ。
ex_en: Only by experiencing it yourself can you truly understand it.
notes: Stresses that A is the essential condition for the real value or result in B. 〜てはじめて (N3) is more neutral, focusing on timing.

meaning_en: not until (after doing); only after
formation: Verb-te + からでないと / Verb-te + からでなければ
ex_ja: 実物を見てからでないと、買うかどうか決められない。
ex_en: I can't decide whether to buy it until I've seen the real thing.
notes: The main clause is negative or expresses difficulty: B can't happen unless A is done first.

meaning_en: ever since
formation: Verb-te + 以来 / Noun + 以来
ex_ja: 大学を卒業して以来、彼とは一度も会っていない。
ex_en: I haven't seen him once since we graduated from university.
notes: The main clause is a state or habit continuing from that past point up to now, not a single later event. More formal than 〜てから.

meaning_en: merely; nothing more than; only
formation: Verb-plain / Noun + に過ぎない
ex_ja: それは単なるうわさに過ぎない。
ex_en: That's nothing more than a rumor.
notes: Downplays something as small or unimportant. Often with ただ or 単なる.

meaning_en: nothing beats; the best thing is
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / Noun + に限る
ex_ja: 疲れたときは、早く寝るに限る。
ex_en: When you're tired, there's nothing better than going to bed early.
notes: The speaker's personal conviction that something is the best choice; conversational. For a more general 'it's best to', use 〜に越したことはない.

meaning_en: not only; not limited to
formation: Noun + に限らず
ex_ja: この遊園地は、子どもに限らず大人にも人気がある。
ex_en: This amusement park is popular not only with children but with adults as well.
notes: Widens the scope beyond A; the second part usually has も. Close to 〜だけでなく but a bit more formal.

meaning_en: of all (times/people); precisely when; (someone) of all people wouldn't
formation: Noun + に限って
ex_ja: 傘を持っていない日に限って、雨が降るんだよね。
ex_en: It always rains on exactly the days I don't have an umbrella.
notes: Two uses: (1) 'just when', complaining that bad luck strikes at the worst time; (2) with はずがない / ない, firm trust that a particular person wouldn't do something.

meaning_en: limited to; only (for)
formation: Noun + に限り
ex_ja: 本日ご来店のお客様に限り、全商品を二割引きいたします。
ex_en: For customers visiting today only, all items are 20% off.
notes: Formal; typical of notices, ads and rules to state who or what a condition applies to.

meaning_en: as long as; as far as (to the limit of)
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / i-Adj / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + かぎり
ex_ja: 私の知るかぎり、彼が約束を破ったことは一度もない。
ex_en: As far as I know, he has never once broken a promise.
notes: 'As long as' a condition holds, or 'as far as' the limit of knowledge or ability (私の知るかぎり, できるかぎり). Also written 限り. Different from 〜に限り (limited to).

meaning_en: unless; as long as ... not
formation: Verb-nai + かぎり
ex_ja: よほどのことがないかぎり、明日の会議には出席します。
ex_en: Unless something serious comes up, I'll attend tomorrow's meeting.
notes: B holds as long as A doesn't happen. More emphatic and formal than 〜なければ.

meaning_en: when it comes to; in terms of (skill)
formation: Noun + にかけては / Noun + にかけても
ex_ja: 料理の腕にかけては、うちの父は誰にも負けない。
ex_en: When it comes to cooking, my father is second to none.
notes: Praises someone's ability in a specific field; typically followed by 誰にも負けない, 一番だ, 自信がある.

meaning_en: in response to; meeting (expectations, requests)
formation: Noun + にこたえて / Noun + にこたえる + Noun
ex_ja: ファンの声援にこたえて、選手たちは手を振った。
ex_en: The players waved in response to the fans' cheers.
notes: Used with nouns like 期待, 要望, 声援, 要求. Also written 〜に応えて. Compare 〜に応じて, which means adjusting to a condition.

meaning_en: prior to; before
formation: Noun + に先立って / Verb-dict + に先立って / Noun + に先立つ + Noun
ex_ja: 新作映画の公開に先立って、完成披露試写会が開かれた。
ex_en: Prior to the release of the new film, a premiere screening was held.
notes: Formal; for preparations or events that come before an important occasion. 〜に先立ち is the written form.

meaning_en: even if; whether ... or ...; in any case
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + にしろ・にせよ
ex_ja: たとえ冗談にしろ、そんなことを言うべきではない。
ex_en: Even if it was a joke, you shouldn't say something like that.
notes: Same meaning as 〜にしても (N3) but more formal; にせよ is the most written. The paired form AにしろBにしろ means 'whether A or B'.

meaning_en: from the standpoint of; for (someone), (it would seem)
formation: Noun + にすれば / Noun + にしたら
ex_ja: 子どもにすれば、親の小言はうるさいだけなのだろう。
ex_en: From a child's point of view, parents' nagging is probably just annoying.
notes: Imagines how things feel from another person's position (usually not the speaker's). Unlike 〜にとって, it focuses on that person's feelings or opinion.

meaning_en: without doubt; must be; surely
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に相違ない
ex_ja: この筆跡は、父のものに相違ない。
ex_en: This handwriting is without doubt my father's.
notes: A written, formal equivalent of 〜に違いない (N3). Also seen on forms: 上記の通り相違ありません ('the above is correct').

meaning_en: it's best to; nothing is better than
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に越したことはない
ex_ja: どんなに健康でも、定期的に検診を受けるに越したことはない。
ex_en: No matter how healthy you are, it's best to get regular checkups.
notes: States a common-sense preference, often followed by が / けれど and a practical reservation. Compare 〜に限る, which is a more personal choice.

meaning_en: nothing other than; none other than; precisely
formation: Noun + にほかならない / Verb-plain + から + にほかならない
ex_ja: 今回の成功は、社員一人ひとりの努力の結果にほかならない。
ex_en: This success is nothing other than the result of each employee's efforts.
notes: Strongly asserts that this and nothing else is the case. 〜からにほかならない stresses a reason. Formal/written.

meaning_en: despite; in spite of; although
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + である / Noun + にもかかわらず
ex_ja: 悪天候にもかかわらず、大勢の観客が会場に集まった。
ex_en: Despite the bad weather, a large crowd gathered at the venue.
notes: A formal counterpart of 〜のに, common in news and writing; stresses that the result goes against what A would lead one to expect. Don't confuse with 〜にかかわらず (regardless of).

meaning_en: when; at the time of; on the occasion of (starting something important)
formation: Noun + にあたって / Verb-dict + にあたって / Noun + にあたっての + Noun
ex_ja: 新生活を始めるにあたって、必要な物をリストにまとめた。
ex_en: When starting my new life, I made a list of the things I'd need.
notes: Formal; used when facing an important undertaking, often with a sense of preparation or resolve. 〜に際して is similar but simply marks the occasion. Written form: 〜にあたり.

meaning_en: in; at; in the field of (formal)
formation: Noun + において / Noun + における + Noun
ex_ja: 卒業式は大講堂において行われます。
ex_en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main auditorium.
notes: A formal version of で for places, times, fields or situations. Before a noun, the form is 〜における.

meaning_en: regardless of; irrespective of
formation: Noun + にかかわらず / Verb-dict + Verb-nai + にかかわらず
ex_ja: このセミナーは、経験の有無にかかわらず、どなたでも参加できます。
ex_en: Anyone can join this seminar, regardless of experience.
notes: Used with nouns implying a range or an opposite pair (年齢, 天候, 有無, 男女). Very close to 〜を問わず. Don't confuse with 〜にもかかわらず (despite).

meaning_en: affecting; concerning (something important); relating to
formation: Noun + にかかわる
ex_ja: これは人の命にかかわる問題だから、慎重に判断しなければならない。
ex_en: This is a matter of life and death, so we must judge carefully.
notes: Used for things with serious consequences: 命, 名誉, 信用, 将来. Also written 〜に関わる.

meaning_en: per; for each; due to (in formal notices)
formation: Noun + につき
ex_ja: 駐車料金は、一時間につき三百円です。
ex_en: Parking costs 300 yen per hour.
notes: Two separate uses: 'per' with quantities, and 'because of' on notices and signs (工事中につき). The reason use is very formal.

meaning_en: toward; aimed at; in preparation for; addressed to
formation: Noun + に向けて / Noun + に向けた + Noun
ex_ja: 来年の全国大会に向けて、毎日練習に励んでいる。
ex_en: We're practicing hard every day for next year's national tournament.
notes: Marks a goal or event being worked toward, or the audience something is directed at. Different from 〜向け (N3), 'designed for'.

meaning_en: under (guidance, influence, a rule); with
formation: Noun + のもとで / Noun + のもとに
ex_ja: 私は大学院で、有名な教授のもとで研究を続けた。
ex_en: In graduate school, I continued my research under a famous professor.
notes: Under someone's guidance, protection or influence, or under a rule or condition. Often written 〜の下で / 〜の下に.

meaning_en: without; leaving out
formation: Noun + 抜きで / Noun + 抜きに / Noun + 抜きの + Noun
ex_ja: 今日は仕事の話抜きで、ゆっくり楽しみましょう。
ex_en: Let's leave work talk out of it today and just relax and enjoy ourselves.
notes: Leaves out something normally included. 〜抜きには〜ない / 〜を抜きにしては〜ない means 'can't ... without'.

meaning_en: with (feeling); full of; putting ... into
formation: Noun + をこめて
ex_ja: 母の誕生日に、感謝の気持ちをこめて手紙を書いた。
ex_en: For my mother's birthday, I wrote her a letter full of gratitude.
notes: Used with feelings or intentions (愛, 感謝, 願い, 心). Also written 〜を込めて.

meaning_en: centered on; focusing on; mainly
formation: Noun + を中心に / Noun + を中心として / Noun + を中心とした + Noun
ex_ja: 今回の地震では、沿岸部を中心に大きな被害が出た。
ex_en: In this earthquake, serious damage occurred mainly in coastal areas.
notes: A is the core or main part of a wider area, group or activity.

meaning_en: based on; using ... as a basis or source
formation: Noun + をもとに / Noun + をもとにして / Noun + をもとにした + Noun
ex_ja: この小説は、作者自身の体験をもとに書かれている。
ex_en: This novel is based on the author's own experiences.
notes: A is the material or hint from which something new is made. 〜に基づいて is used when strictly following a rule or fact as a standard.

meaning_en: regardless of; irrespective of
formation: Noun + を問わず
ex_ja: この仕事は、年齢や経験を問わず応募できます。
ex_en: Anyone can apply for this job regardless of age or experience.
notes: Used with nouns implying a range or an opposite pair (男女, 昼夜, 国内外). Very close to 〜にかかわらず; を問わず is typical of job ads and notices.

meaning_en: starting with; including; such as (a representative example)
formation: Noun + をはじめ / Noun + をはじめとして / Noun + をはじめとする + Noun
ex_ja: 京都には、金閣寺をはじめ、多くの有名な寺がある。
ex_en: Kyoto has many famous temples, including Kinkakuji.
notes: Names the most representative member of a group, then refers to the group as a whole. The main clause covers many items, not just A.

meaning_en: treating (A) as (B); with A as B
formation: Noun + を + Noun + として / Noun + を + Noun + とする
ex_ja: この大会は、地域の活性化を目的として開かれている。
ex_en: This event is held with the aim of revitalizing the local area.
notes: Puts A in the role or function of B; common B nouns are 目的, 目標, 中心, 対象, 条件. 〜を〜にして is a more casual variant.

meaning_en: if you ask whether (actually, not); the reason why ... is
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かというと / Question word + … + かというと
ex_ja: 高い料理ならおいしいかというと、必ずしもそうではない。
ex_en: Is expensive food always delicious? Not necessarily.
notes: With a question word (なぜ, どうして) it introduces an explanation. Without one, it raises a question only to deny the easy assumption (〜かというと、そうではない). Also 〜かといえば.

meaning_en: just when; no sooner than; the moment
formation: Verb-ta + かと思ったら / Verb-ta + かと思うと
ex_ja: 空が急に暗くなったかと思ったら、激しい雨が降り出した。
ex_en: No sooner had the sky suddenly gone dark than it started to pour.
notes: B follows A immediately and unexpectedly. It describes what the speaker observes, so it isn't used for the speaker's own actions.

meaning_en: as soon as; barely ... when
formation: Verb-dict + か + Verb-nai + かのうちに / Verb-ta + か + Verb-nai + かのうちに
ex_ja: ベルが鳴るか鳴らないかのうちに、生徒たちは教室を飛び出した。
ex_en: The bell had barely rung when the students rushed out of the classroom.
notes: The same verb is repeated in positive and negative: it's unclear whether A has even finished before B happens. Describes observed events.

meaning_en: since (and nothing after); only; just
formation: Verb-ta + きり / Noun + きり
ex_ja: 兄は十年前に家を出たきり、一度も連絡をよこさない。
ex_en: My brother left home ten years ago and hasn't been in touch once since.
notes: Verb-ta + きり: something happened and the expected follow-up never came (often with ない). Noun + きり: 'only' (一度きり, 二人きり). Casual: 〜っきり.

meaning_en: seeming; looking (as if); with an air of
formation: i-Adj stem + げ / na-Adj + げ / Verb-stem + たげ
ex_ja: 彼女は窓の外を寂しげに見つめていた。
ex_en: She was gazing out the window with a lonely look.
notes: Describes a feeling visible in someone's face or manner; conjugates like a na-adjective (〜げな, 〜げに). Rather literary.

meaning_en: no way; there's absolutely no chance
formation: Verb-stem + っこない
ex_ja: こんな量の仕事、一日で終わりっこないよ。
ex_en: There's no way this much work will get done in one day.
notes: Casual speech only; often with potential verbs (できっこない, 分かりっこない). A casual equivalent of 〜わけがない.

meaning_en: far from; let alone; on the contrary
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + どころか
ex_ja: 薬を飲んだが、熱は下がるどころか、ますます高くなった。
ex_en: I took medicine, but far from going down, my fever got even higher.
notes: Either the reality is the opposite of A, or not even something lesser than A is possible (AどころかBも〜ない).

meaning_en: this is no time for; out of the question
formation: Verb-dict / Noun + どころではない
ex_ja: 来週は試験なので、遊びに行くどころではない。
ex_en: I have exams next week, so this is no time to be going out.
notes: The circumstances make A impossible or unthinkable right now. Casual: 〜どころじゃない.

meaning_en: not necessarily; not always
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とは限らない
ex_ja: 値段が高いからといって、品質がいいとは限らない。
ex_en: Just because something is expensive doesn't necessarily mean it's good quality.
notes: Denies that something is always true; often with 必ずしも or 〜からといって.

meaning_en: that's what (A) is; that's just how it is; that's really
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というものだ
ex_ja: 困っている人がいたら助ける。それが人情というものだ。
ex_en: When someone's in trouble, you help them. That's what human kindness is.
notes: A firm opinion about what something really is or how things naturally are. Often used to criticize an attitude.

meaning_en: it's not (necessarily) the case that; it doesn't follow that
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というものではない
ex_ja: 練習は長くやればいいというものではない。
ex_en: Longer practice isn't automatically better practice.
notes: Rejects an oversimplified belief; often with 〜ばいい or 〜さえ〜ば. 〜というものでもない is a softer variant.

meaning_en: although I say; even though (it's called)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + といっても
ex_ja: 料理ができるといっても、簡単なものしか作れません。
ex_en: I say I can cook, but I can only make simple things.
notes: Corrects or limits what the listener might assume from the first statement. Often followed by たった, ただ or 〜しか〜ない.

meaning_en: speaking of; when you think of; if you mention
formation: Noun + といえば / Noun + というと
ex_ja: 日本の夏の風物詩といえば、やはり花火大会だろう。
ex_en: When you think of summer traditions in Japan, fireworks festivals come to mind first.
notes: Introduces something closely associated with a topic, or picks up a word just mentioned to shift the conversation. 〜といったら is a more emotional variant.

meaning_en: have no choice but to; there's nothing to do but
formation: Verb-dict + ほかない / Verb-dict + よりほかない
ex_ja: 終電を逃してしまったので、タクシーで帰るほかない。
ex_en: I've missed the last train, so I have no choice but to take a taxi home.
notes: A somewhat formal equivalent of 〜しかない (N3). Variants: 〜ほかはない, 〜よりほかない, 〜ほかしかたがない.

meaning_en: will not (resolve); probably won't (conjecture)
formation: Verb-dict + まい / Verb-stem (ichidan verbs) + まい
ex_ja: あんな恥ずかしい思いは、二度とするまいと心に誓った。
ex_en: I swore to myself that I would never go through such embarrassment again.
notes: Written/formal. First person: firm resolve not to (〜ないつもりだ). Others: negative guess (〜ないだろう). する → するまい / すまい. Often 〜まいと思う / 〜まいと決心する.

meaning_en: let's (formal call to action); why don't we
formation: Verb-volitional + ではないか / Verb-volitional + ではありませんか
ex_ja: この町の未来のために、皆で力を合わせようではないか。
ex_en: For the future of this town, let us all join forces.
notes: A strong, formal appeal to a group, typical of speeches and editorials. The casual version is 〜(よ)うじゃないか.

meaning_en: without caring about; regardless of; paying no attention to
formation: Noun + もかまわず / Verb-plain + の + もかまわず
ex_ja: 彼女は人目もかまわず、駅のホームで大声で泣いた。
ex_en: She cried out loud on the station platform, not caring who was watching.
notes: Doing something without minding what people would normally care about (人目, 周囲, 雨). Often implies disapproval.

meaning_en: from the standpoint of; in terms of; for reasons of
formation: Noun + 上 / Noun + 上の + Noun
ex_ja: この映画には、教育上好ましくない場面が多い。
ex_en: This movie has many scenes that are undesirable from an educational standpoint.
notes: Attaches to Sino-Japanese nouns (歴史上, 経験上, 健康上, 表面上). Read じょう, not うえ.

meaning_en: there is a risk that; could (bad outcome)
formation: Verb-dict + おそれがある / Noun + の + おそれがある
ex_ja: 台風の影響で、今夜から大雨になるおそれがあります。
ex_en: Due to the typhoon, there is a risk of heavy rain from tonight.
notes: For undesirable possibilities; typical of news, weather reports and official warnings. Also written 〜恐れがある. 〜かねない sounds more like the speaker's own judgment.

meaning_en: perhaps because; maybe due to
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + せいか
ex_ja: 年のせいか、最近疲れが取れにくくなった。
ex_en: Maybe it's my age, but lately it takes longer to recover from fatigue.
notes: The speaker isn't sure of the cause. Mostly for bad or neutral results; for good results おかげか is also used.

meaning_en: as might be expected (since); precisely because; all the more because
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけあって・だけに
ex_ja: さすが一流ホテルだけあって、サービスが行き届いている。
ex_en: As you'd expect from a first-class hotel, the service is impeccable.
notes: だけあって praises a result that matches expectations (often with さすが). だけに also means 'all the more because' and can lead to negative outcomes.

meaning_en: it's no wonder; it lives up to; as expected of
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけのことはある
ex_ja: この料理は本当においしい。人気店だけのことはある。
ex_en: This food is really delicious. No wonder the place is so popular.
notes: Judges a result as fully justified by the effort, price or reputation; often with さすが. Like 〜だけあって, but placed at the end of the sentence.

meaning_en: even if; no matter
formation: たとえ + Verb-te + も / たとえ + i-Adj-ku + ても / たとえ + na-Adj + でも / たとえ + Noun + でも
ex_ja: たとえ反対されても、自分の夢を諦めるつもりはない。
ex_en: Even if people oppose me, I have no intention of giving up my dream.
notes: たとえ signals a hypothetical 'even if' in advance and strengthens it. A more written variant is たとえ〜としても.

meaning_en: what with ... and ...; and ... and (among other things)
formation: Noun + やら + Noun + やら / Verb-dict + やら + Verb-dict + やら / i-Adj + やら + i-Adj + やら
ex_ja: 引っ越しの前は、荷造りやら手続きやらで目が回るほど忙しかった。
ex_en: Before the move, what with packing and paperwork, I was run off my feet.
notes: Lists a few examples among many, often suggesting chaos or mixed feelings. Frequently followed by で + 大変だ / 忙しい.

meaning_en: get by without; not have to; be spared from
formation: Verb-nai stem + ずに済む / Verb-nai + で済む
ex_ja: 友人が車で送ってくれたので、タクシーを使わずに済んだ。
ex_en: My friend gave me a ride, so I didn't have to take a taxi.
notes: Something unpleasant or costly turned out to be unnecessary. する → せずに済む. Compare Noun + で済む, 'be settled with just ...'.

meaning_en: depending on how (one does it)
formation: Verb-stem + ようによっては
ex_ja: 考えようによっては、今回の失敗はいい教訓になったとも言える。
ex_en: Depending on how you look at it, you could say this failure taught us a good lesson.
notes: Mostly with 考え, 見, 言い, 使い: the result changes with the way A is done. Often offers a positive reinterpretation.
